results_due: around May 2027 (half-yearly reporter; H1 was reported on 27 Oct)
reasoning: H1 FY27 revenue was ₹194.5 Cr (+95%). The MD said 'we should be able to have a balanced H2 and H1', with only a marginal difference, so H2 of about ₹205 Cr. That puts FY27 near ₹400 Cr, at the top of the ₹360-400 Cr guided in May. An analyst's ₹450-500 Cr was not confirmed.

Order book is ₹760 Cr (₹400 Cr in April), executable over 15-18 months, so demand is not the constraint; capacity is. Brownfield expansion finishes in Q3 and adds capacity visible in Q4, and the greenfield plant invoices mainly through assembly of imported cores until local type tests finish.

EBITDA margin was 28.1% in H1 against a 24-25% FY27 guide. The MD aims 'to maintain it or better' but would not commit. We use 27.5%. Depreciation will rise to 2.5-3x last year's, mostly in H2, which holds PAT growth below EBITDA growth.
risks: Greenfield type test or customer approval slips, keeping reliance on imported cores
Customers pulled orders into H1 ('balanced' H2 is a change from past years when H2 was bigger)
caveat: Half-yearly estimates are on Screener's standalone rows.
